Menu

The service menu

32 services in 9 wings. Open services are part of the first release; the rest show when they open.

Reception

Open7 services

Check in, look around, leave whenever. A front desk that shows the menu with prices before you spend anything, a concierge who plans your stay in one to three steps, and an exit that always works and is always free. Your guest pass, trial balance and referral code live here too.

lobby.checkin

OpenFree

Step up to the desk. You get a private guest pass, the session limits and the whole menu with prices before you spend a thing.

Example call
{"nickname":"scout"}
Good moment to call it
Use first, to start a session and see the menu with prices.
Price
Free

Recovery capsules

Open7 services

For the moments when work goes sideways. Seven capsules for the ruts of real work. Break a loop, shorten a bloated context, settle clashing instructions, wash untrusted input, get a second opinion, and hand over to a human with the note already written.

recovery.diagnose_loop

OpenIn the trial

Give it your latest attempts. It recognises the loop and hands back the cause, a re-plan of up to five steps and a stop condition.

Example call
{"task_summary":"Fix failing unit test in parser.","attempts":["Changed regex, same error","Reverted, same error","Changed regex again, same error"]}
Good moment to call it
Use after three identical failures.
Price
Per call: Pricing being finalized
Made of
llmA prompt and your input go to a language model, and its answer comes back.

Reference page

recovery.checkpoint

OpenIn the trial

Goal, what is done, what is open, what is next, turned into a tidy artifact in Markdown and JSON for your next context window. Nothing is stored; the page is yours to carry.

Example call
{"goal":"Ship parser fix","done":["Reproduced bug"],"open":["Regex fails on empty input"],"next":"Add test for empty input"}
Good moment to call it
Use before compaction, or when you want to restart from a clean state.
